entries.0367a12a49bfdecf: Construction and management of billing and membership systems
entries.2e535940bb46b1c2: A company that develops and distributes PC online games and mobile games such as "MapleStory" and "Dungeon&Fighter" around the world.
entries.37cde10c99c73d26: This segment covers the distribution of PC online games and mobile games mainly in North America by the US consolidated subsidiaries Nexon America Inc. and Toben Studio Inc. The holding company Nexon US Holding Inc. is also included in this segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥28,125 million (an increase of 59.7% from the previous year).
entries.5ae81091d5e3023b: This segment covers the distribution of PC online games and mobile games in Japan by NEXON Co., Ltd. itself, a business holding company, which also manages affiliated companies. It also forms business alliances with domestic peers and others, and plays a role in expanding games developed by other domestic companies to markets in various countries through the group. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,509 million (a 10.0% decrease from the previous year).
entries.84bc66295ba3d920: This segment covers consulting services (business strategy, game operations and marketing) and infrastructure provided by the consolidated subsidiary Lexian Software Development (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. to game distribution companies in China. Under Chinese regulatory restrictions, companies with foreign capital cannot directly distribute PC online games, so this structure is used. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,774 million (a 32.3% decrease from the previous year).
entries.889aaf7c2a62f31a: Game development and distribution (Embark Studios AB)
entries.8f65739fa60f8a1e: This segment covers the development and distribution of PC online games and mobile games by the Korean consolidated subsidiary NEXON Korea Corporation and its subsidiaries NEOPLE INC., NEXON Games Co., Ltd. and others. The intellectual property (IP) of “MapleStory” is held by NEXON Korea Corporation, and that of “Arad Senki” by NEOPLE INC.; each grants exclusive distribution rights for individual games to distribution companies outside the group and receives royalties. Revenue of this segment includes royalty revenue from licensing by NEOPLE INC. in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥400,657 million (a 3.0% decrease from the previous year).
entries.a9002f921ae5539d: This segment combines Europe and Asian countries. Its main consolidated subsidiary is Embark Studios AB of Sweden, which mainly develops and distributes games in Europe. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥39,037 million (an increase of 477.1% from the previous year), making it the second largest reportable segment after Korea.
